sloka: घृताच्याम् किल संसक्तो दश वर्षाणि लक्ष्मण ।अहो अमन्यत धर्मात्मा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ॥४-३५-७॥
transliteration: ghṛtācyām kila saṁsakto daśa varṣāṇi lakṣmaṇa ।aho amanyata dharmātmā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ॥4-35-7॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana great sage Visvamitra was in union with an apsara Gritachi for ten years and felt it was just one day indeed
